profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test at Vertafore
profile.summary:
Helping software development teams work more efficiently.
Improving quality and reducing costs through automation and collaboration tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer In Test
positions.description:
•	Founding member of Vertafore Continuous Delivery and Continuous Quality teams.
•	Created and implemented an Agile Train Development Process. This train process begins with a CI builds. Versioned builds are stored in a repository management system. Builds are promoted from development to certification and finally to production environments. More than 50 Vertafore products use this train process and tools my CD/CQ team created. This train process performs several hundred deployments per month. Uses TFS/SVN/Git, various build tools and languages, Jenkins, Gitlab and Artifactory.
•	Introduced and implemented continuous quality monitoring system. Uses Agile Train CI builds and the SonarQube tool to track code quality. Most Vertafore products are monitored using these processes and tools.
•	Helped develop and establish DEVOP culture at Vertafore.
•	Introduced and implemented first cloud projects at Vertafore using both AWS and Skytap.
•	Troubleshooted and maintained network and hardware systems between Vertafore and Skytap could service provider.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Investigated various hacks and cheats used against Games for Windows titles.
•	Tested anti-debug system for Games for Windows.
•	Researched and discovered technology used to cheat high profile Games for Windows titles.
•	Tested various Games for Windows security features.

positions.title: Senior QA Engieer
positions.description:
•	Implemented a continuous build integration and test system for an MMORPG.
•	Trained artists and game developers on branch merge processes.
•	Developed a bot and avatar tracking system to test an MMORPG.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed test automation framework.
•	Set up continuous integration build environments.
•	Set up CI metrics reporting and automation for nightly builds and code coverage.
•	Created custom tools to test Haydrian’s products.
•	Created unit tests for Java and Python. Integrated these with code coverage systems.
•	Setup and maintained issues tracking system.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Black box and gray box tested mobile application on various platforms
•	Helped document Action Engine’s SDK and wrote sample code.
•	Created unit tests for SDK and mobile application.
•	Gathered code coverage and other source code metrics for SDK and mobile applications.
•	Managed outsourced test engineers in India.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop multi-threading sockets networking applications in C++ and ACE to detect presence of cellular phone subscribers. Ran on both UNIX and Windows platforms.
- Created and implemented automated code coverage testing process.
- Created and implemented code review process.
- Taught and developed course on the Unified Software Development Process.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Invented, designed and developed 3D storage and retrieval system for medical ultrasound. Awarded U.S. Patent 6,370,413.
•	Re-engineered 3D ultrasound system to solve performance issues.
•	Designed and developed image exam review feature for medical ultrasound device. Networked with hospital information systems.
•	Designed and developed patient database system for medical ultrasound device.
•	Maintained printer, camera and VCR device drivers for a medical ultrasound device.
•	Performance tested ultrasound exam review and imaging systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed software in C++ for various UNIX platforms, MS-Windows and MacOS. 
•	Helped develop C++Views class library to UNIX platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed loan refinance software in C++. 
•	Developed PostScript printer drivers.

patents.title: Bit level comparator systems and methods
Ultrasound imaging system and method to archive and review 3-D ultrasound data
